svg.data-weight-note: 15.8 lb (7.1 kg) chassis; each fan module 0.28 lb (0.13 kg); each 500 W AC power supply 2.42 lb (1.1 kg), no weight given for the other supplies
svg.data-management-ports: guide: "Two management ports (one 10/100/1000BASE-T port and one SFP port)"
svg.data-regulatory: Products should comply with CEMarkings according to directives 2004/108/EC and 2006/95/EC.
svg.data-safety: CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 60950-1 Second Edition, CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 62368-1-19 Third Edition, ANSI/UL 60950-1 Second edition, IEC 62368-1, EN 62368-1, AS/NZS 62368-1, GB4943, UL 62368-1
svg.data-emissions: 47CFR Part 15 (CFR 47) Class A, AS/NZS CISPR22 Class A, CISPR22 Class A, EN55022 Class A, ICES003 Class A, VCCI Class A, EN61000-3-2, EN61000-3-3, KN22 Class A, CNS13438 Class A
svg.data-rohs: The product is RoH-6 compliant with exceptions for leaded-ball grid-array (BGA) balls and lead press-fit connectors.
